title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse PS5 discs delayed reaching Saudi Arabia, expected in stores next week (Konami Arabic)

sources.name: KONAMI بالعربي (@KONAMI_AR, verified, official Arabic account)

claims.text: PS5 physical copies delayed reaching Saudi Arabia due to tightened security restrictions in the region
Expected in stores within the next week; Konami apologises
Game released 15 Oct on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, PC

notes: First report: Konami's own post 13:53Z; first press VGA4A 19:11Z. Only PS5 discs named; no new day given.
